source: The issuers' own pages first (Chase, Capital One, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, US Bank, Citi through Mastercard's Citi page, American Express, Apple), read on 2026-11-06; a review site where the issuer page would not load (verified: secondary); the rest from what was known in mid 2026 (verified: unverified, with what to check). confidenceNote: Fees, APR ranges and rewards change often and sign-up bonuses are left out on purpose. Each card says how it was checked; the coach can tweak every number on the client's own card.
note: rates: x points (or percent) per dollar in a category; capYear is the spend a year that earns it (shared: the caps of the rates with the same tag are one cap); oneOf: the client's biggest of these categories; rotating: quarterly categories, shown but not counted. pointValue: dollars per point in SLAM's math (the cash or travel-portal floor). credits: value is dollars a year if used. benefits: words only. apr: the typical range, shown as a hint; the client's own APR is the number used.
